title: Review changes with clear text and execution flows
intent: Follow complete execution paths. Inspect contracts, source references, and evidence at each step.

groups.title: Execution review
groups.summary: Review the complete request path and inspect one contract at a time.

components.name: Host assistant
components.intended: Record complete execution paths and write short, consistent review text.
components.observed: Author guidance defines ordered scenarios, contract evidence, and STE-inspired writing rules.
components.risk: Missing facts must remain unknown rather than invented.

components.name: Browser diagram
components.current: Show expanded component cards with responsibilities and outgoing contract details.
components.intended: Show execution paths and inspect individual contracts without expanding component cards.
components.observed: Scenario tracing and contract details are implemented. Narrow panels show complete steps with readable source and destination labels.
components.risk: Readability still needs evaluation with software engineers.

components.name: Workspace server
components.current: Serve revision-bound specs, reports and feedback.
components.intended: Serve revision-bound specs, reports and feedback.
components.observed: Existing state endpoint forwards the enriched spec unchanged.

components.name: Spec validator
components.current: Validate responsibilities, relations and source binding.
components.intended: Validate scenario steps, version availability, evidence links, and source binding.
components.observed: The validator rejects missing relations, disconnected steps, invalid version references, and unsafe source paths.
components.risk: Shape and freshness checks cannot verify factual architecture quality.

components.name: Spec and baseline files
components.current: Store intent, recorded evidence and proposal baseline.
components.intended: Store intent, recorded evidence and proposal baseline.
components.observed: New metadata uses the existing atomic spec-file writer.

components.name: Proposal engine
components.current: Preserve typed component and relation edits across adoption.
components.intended: Preserve typed component and relation edits across adoption.
components.observed: Runtime tests verify that typed proposals preserve scenario additions and removals.

components.name: Writing checker
components.current: The workspace did not check sentence length.
components.intended: Flag long sentences without changing technical claims.
components.observed: The checker reports sentence-length warnings. It does not claim STE compliance.

decisions.title: Clear text and interactive execution flows
decisions.choice: Use STE-inspired text, complete execution scenarios, and interactive tracing. Defer videos.
alternatives: Show only a dependency overview and separate prose.
consequences: The author records each path from its trigger to its outcome.
Sentence checks are advisory. The reviewer retains technical terms.
Connections expose contracts, failure behavior, source paths, evidence, and decisions.

evidence.claim: Recorded scenarios match the inspected local request and acknowledgement paths.
evidence.detail: Inspected state retrieval, token rejection, and acknowledgement idempotency in the server. Inspected scenario validation and writing checks in the runtime. The preview shows the recorded request and response paths.

evidence.claim: Scenario validation, writing checks, and proposal edits preserve their contracts.
evidence.detail: npm run check passed JavaScript syntax checks and all 38 Python tests. Tests cover scenario references, connected steps, version availability, safe paths, proposal adoption, and advisory writing checks.

evidence.claim: Reviewers can trace success, failure, and retry paths and inspect linked evidence.
evidence.detail: All four Chromium scenarios passed. Checks cover success, rejection, retries, evidence, contextual feedback, and keyboard controls. Narrow-panel checks verify every label fits and resizing preserves the active step.

acceptanceCriteria: Existing specs and proposal edits remain compatible.
Scenario steps connect and refer to relations available in that version.
The reviewer can select a scenario and trace its steps.
Connections expose contracts, failure behavior, source paths, evidence, and decisions.
Before and Intended preserve participant positions.
Feedback records the selected scenario, version, and step.
Sentence checks report length warnings without rewriting source text.
nonGoals: A claim of STE compliance or measured human comprehension.
Automatically deriving execution order from dependencies.
Fixing the separate PR comparison coverage issue.

scenarios.title: Read workspace state
scenarios.trigger: The browser requests the current workspace state.
scenarios.outcome: The browser receives the spec, source report, and feedback.

scenarios.title: Reject a missing token
scenarios.trigger: The browser sends a request without the session token.
scenarios.outcome: The server returns HTTP 401 before it reads the spec.

scenarios.title: Retry an acknowledgement
scenarios.trigger: The host repeats an acknowledgement for the same event.
scenarios.outcome: The server confirms the event without duplicating its reply.
